number.why: The reported AAD risk ratio for probiotic versus placebo is 0.7 with 95% CI 0.4–1.2. Agreement is limited to the published estimate: as the ruling acknowledges, the abstracts do not establish intention-to-treat analysis or an explicit assessment timepoint. The stated 14 days describe therapy duration.

quotes.span: The incidence of AAD in the probiotic group was 10.8% compared to 15.6% in the placebo group, the difference being statistically non-significant (p = 0.19).
The relative risk for AAD was 0.7 with the 95% CI being 0.4 to 1.2.
The effectiveness of a 14-day therapy (concomitant with antibiotic course and seven days thereafter) of the probiotic formulation in preventing AAD was evaluated.

entry.why: Adults prescribed antibiotics, with probiotic therapy concomitant with the antibiotic course, satisfy the question's entry population of patients receiving antibiotics.

quotes.span: A double-blind randomised placebo controlled multicentric trial was conducted in adults who were prescribed a seven-day course of oral antibiotic (either cefadroxil or amoxycillin) for a documented indication.
The effectiveness of a 14-day therapy (concomitant with antibiotic course and seven days thereafter) of the probiotic formulation in preventing AAD was evaluated.

missed: Nothing identified that changes either judgment. Confirmation of the reported number does not establish the served intention-to-treat population or study-end timepoint; the ruling already records these limitations.
